points.title: 贵族少年
points.description: 加富尔出生于都灵一个古老的皮埃蒙特贵族家庭，从小接受精英教育。他的父亲是侯爵，母亲是法国人。少年时期的加富尔展现出对农业和经济的浓厚兴趣，而非传统贵族子弟热衷的军事生涯。1826年，他进入都灵皇家军事学院学习，但很快对军事生涯失去热情，转而专注于经济和政治研究。这段时期奠定了他后来务实、注重经济发展的政治风格。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Turin to an ancient Piedmontese noble family, Cavour received an elite education from an early age. His father was a marquis and his mother was French. As a youth, Cavour showed a keen interest in agriculture and economics rather than the military career typical of aristocratic sons. In 1826, he entered the Royal Military Academy in Turin but quickly lost enthusiasm for a military career, turning instead to the study of economics and politics. This period laid the foundation for his later pragmatic political style focused on economic development.

points.title: 欧洲漫游
points.description: 离开军事学院后，加富尔开始了广泛的欧洲旅行，访问了瑞士、法国、英国等地。在英国期间，他深受自由主义思想和工业革命的影响，对英国的议会制度和经济发展模式极为赞赏。这段经历使他形成了自由主义经济思想和亲英立场。1847年，他创办了《复兴报》，倡导意大利统一和现代化改革。这些经历为他后来的政治生涯奠定了思想基础，使他成为意大利统一运动中具有现代视野的领导人。
points.descriptionEn: After leaving the military academy, Cavour embarked on extensive travels across Europe, visiting Switzerland, France, and the United Kingdom. During his time in Britain, he was deeply influenced by liberal thought and the Industrial Revolution, developing great admiration for Britain's parliamentary system and economic model. This experience shaped his liberal economic thinking and pro-British stance. In 1847, he founded the newspaper 'Il Risorgimento' advocating Italian unification and modern reforms. These experiences laid the ideological foundation for his later political career, making him a leader in the Italian unification movement with a modern vision.

points.title: 政治崛起
points.description: 1848年欧洲革命期间，加富尔进入政坛，当选为撒丁王国议会议员。他展现出卓越的政治才能，在议会中积极推动经济改革和现代化政策。1849年，他被任命为农业和商业部长，开始实施一系列自由主义经济改革，包括降低关税、发展铁路和促进工业发展。这些政策使撒丁王国成为意大利最发达的地区之一。1852年，他出任首相，开始实施更为激进的政治和经济改革，为后来的意大利统一奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: During the 1848 European revolutions, Cavour entered politics, elected to the Parliament of the Kingdom of Sardinia. He demonstrated exceptional political talent, actively promoting economic reforms and modernization policies in parliament. In 1849, he was appointed Minister of Agriculture and Commerce, beginning to implement a series of liberal economic reforms including tariff reductions, railway development, and industrial promotion. These policies made the Kingdom of Sardinia one of the most developed regions in Italy. In 1852, he became Prime Minister, implementing more radical political and economic reforms that laid the foundation for Italian unification.

points.title: 外交大师
points.description: 作为撒丁王国的首相，加富尔展现出卓越的外交才能。他认识到仅靠撒丁王国的力量无法实现意大利统一，因此巧妙地利用大国之间的矛盾。1855年，他派遣撒丁军队参加克里米亚战争，支持法国对抗俄国，以此换取拿破仑三世对意大利统一的支持。1858年，他与拿破仑三世签订秘密协议，约定法国将帮助撒丁王国对抗奥地利，作为回报，撒丁王国将给予法国部分领土。这一外交策略为意大利统一战争创造了有利条件，展现了加富尔作为政治家的远见和手腕。
points.descriptionEn: As Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Sardinia, Cavour demonstrated exceptional diplomatic talent. He recognized that Italian unification could not be achieved with Sardinia's strength alone, so he skillfully exploited contradictions among great powers. In 1855, he sent Sardinian troops to participate in the Crimean War, supporting France against Russia in exchange for Napoleon III's support for Italian unification. In 1858, he signed a secret agreement with Napoleon III, stipulating that France would help Sardinia against Austria in return for territorial concessions. This diplomatic strategy created favorable conditions for the Italian unification wars, showcasing Cavour's foresight and political skill as a statesman.

points.title: 统一大业
points.description: 1859年，加富尔与法国联合对奥地利作战，取得初步胜利。虽然拿破仑三世中途退出战争，但这场战争激发了意大利各地的民族起义。1860年，加富尔巧妙地利用加里波第的千人军行动，将西西里和那不勒斯并入撒丁王国。1861年，意大利王国宣告成立，加富尔出任首任首相。然而，他未能看到意大利完全统一，于1861年6月6日因中风在都灵去世。尽管如此，他通过外交手段和战略规划，成功实现了意大利大部分地区的统一，被誉为意大利统一运动的'设计师'。
points.descriptionEn: In 1859, Cavour, in alliance with France, went to war against Austria and achieved initial victories. Although Napoleon III withdrew from the war midway, it sparked nationalist uprisings across Italy. In 1860, Cavour skillfully exploited Giuseppe Garibaldi's Expedition of the Thousand, incorporating Sicily and Naples into the Kingdom of Sardinia. In 1861, the Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed, with Cavour as its first Prime Minister. However, he did not live to see Italy completely unified, dying of a stroke in Turin on June 6, 1861. Nevertheless, through diplomatic means and strategic planning, he successfully achieved the unification of most of Italy, earning him the title of 'architect' of the Italian unification movement.

appraisal.zh: 加富尔被公认为19世纪欧洲最杰出的政治家之一，他以现实主义政治结合民族理想，通过外交手腕与务实政策把分散的意大利各邦引向统一，其现代化改革为工业发展奠定基础，并建立了宪政制度。另一种看法认为，他过于依赖法国等外国势力，与拿破仑三世的秘密协议被视为道德妥协，且未能将威尼斯和罗马纳入新王国，其贵族出身也让一些民主派视他为精英主义者。学界普遍认为，没有他的战略规划，意大利统一或会延迟数十年。
appraisal.en: Cavour is widely regarded as one of 19th-century Europe's outstanding statesmen, combining realpolitik with national ideals to draw the fragmented Italian states toward unification through diplomacy and pragmatic reform, laying foundations for industry and establishing a constitutional order. Another view holds that he leaned too heavily on foreign powers, notably France, that his secret agreement with Napoleon III amounted to moral compromise, that Venice and Rome remained outside the new kingdom, and that his aristocratic background made him seem an elitist to some democrats. Historians generally agree that without his strategic planning, unification might have been delayed by decades.

supporter.zh: 加富尔被意大利民族主义者视为国家统一的伟大设计师。他通过精妙的外交手腕和务实政策，成功将分散的意大利各邦整合为一个统一的国家。他推行的现代化改革和经济政策为意大利的工业发展奠定了基础，使意大利成为欧洲强国之一。加富尔的政治智慧和远见使他超越了同时代的民族主义者，成为意大利统一运动中最具战略头脑的领导人。
supporter.en: Cavour is regarded by Italian nationalists as the great architect of national unification. Through his masterful diplomacy and pragmatic policies, he successfully integrated the various Italian states into a unified nation. The modernization reforms and economic policies he implemented laid the foundation for Italy's industrial development, making it one of the great powers in Europe. Cavour's political wisdom and foresight transcended his contemporary nationalists, making him the most strategically minded leader in the Italian unification movement.

critic.zh: 批评者认为加富尔过于依赖外国势力，特别是法国，来实现意大利统一，损害了意大利的民族独立。他的实用主义政治手段被批评为道德妥协，尤其是与拿破仑三世的秘密协议。此外，他未能实现意大利的完全统一，未能将威尼斯和罗马纳入新成立的意大利王国。加富尔的贵族背景也使他被一些民主派人士视为精英主义者，而非真正的民主革命者。
critic.en: Critics argue that Cavour relied too heavily on foreign powers, particularly France, to achieve Italian unification, compromising Italy's national independence. His pragmatic political methods have been criticized as moral compromises, especially the secret agreement with Napoleon III. Furthermore, he failed to achieve complete Italian unification, unable to incorporate Venice and Rome into the newly formed Kingdom of Italy. Cavour's aristocratic background also led some democratic figures to view him as an elitist rather than a true democratic revolutionary.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，加富尔被公认为19世纪欧洲最杰出的政治家之一。他成功地将现实主义政治与民族理想相结合，创造了独特的意大利统一路径。在流行文化中，加富尔常被描绘为意大利统一运动的幕后推手，与加里波第的浪漫主义形象形成鲜明对比。他的政治遗产包括建立了意大利的宪政制度和现代化经济体系，这些影响延续至今。历史学家普遍认为，没有加富尔的外交智慧和战略规划，意大利的统一进程可能会延迟数十年甚至更长时间。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Cavour is widely regarded as one of the most outstanding statesmen of 19th-century Europe. He successfully combined realpolitik with national ideals, creating a unique path to Italian unification. In popular culture, Cavour is often depicted as the mastermind behind the Italian unification movement, contrasting sharply with Garibaldi's romantic image. His political legacy includes establishing Italy's constitutional system and modern economy, influences that continue to this day. Historians generally agree that without Cavour's diplomatic wisdom and strategic planning, Italy's unification process might have been delayed by decades or even longer.

self.zh: 意大利必须通过战争来获得独立，但必须通过外交来获得统一。
self.en: Italy must be made independent by war, but unified by diplomacy.
